Metadata.name: mamacrochet
Metadata.title: Handmade crochet, made with love — just for you
Metadata.description: Handmade crochet bags and cozy little pieces, crafted one stitch at a time. Dreaming of something specific? Chat with us and we'll make it — no account needed to start.

Hero.title: Soft, cozy crochet — made just for you
Hero.subtitle: Every piece is handcrafted by mama, one stitch at a time. Tell us your idea in chat — no account needed to start.

Values.title: Why mamacrochet
Values.customBody: Nothing mass-produced. Every piece is started the moment you order it — yours from the very first stitch.
Values.ideasBody: Dreaming of something specific? Send a photo or a sketch in chat and we'll crochet it just for you.
Values.liveBody: Your order has a live status board — see when it's in the works, ready for payment, and on its way to you.

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.step1Body: Tell us what you're dreaming of — a bag, a doll, a custom piece — right in chat, no account needed.
HowItWorks.step2Body: Mama gets to work, stitch by stitch, and you follow the progress live from your own status board.
HowItWorks.step3Body: We agree on payment with a receipt, then your piece travels to you — and the loop is closed.

Shop.body: The first handmade pieces are on their way to the little shop. In the meantime, request the piece you've been dreaming of.

Footer.tagline: Handmade with love, one stitch at a time.

Widget.title: Chat with mama
Widget.opener: Hi! 👋 Ask me anything — about pieces, custom ideas, or delivery.
